row: I have been a practicing veterinarian coming up on 30 years and as soon as I knew there was something I could be when I grew up, I knew it was a veterinarian for me.  I attended Cornell University and proceeded to the University of Florida for my veterinary degree and internship at the Animal Medical Center in New York City.  After practicing traditional medicine for ten years I found many cases were not responding to traditional medications and diet options were few.   As veterinarians, we had depended heavily on the large food companies to provide for the nutritional needs of our patients.  I knew more could be done with nutrition and holistic care and I started on a path to learn more. On this channel, I’m going to give you tips to making home cooking for your pets easy!
